_purpose: Trigger-quality corpus. Each entry is a realistic user prompt with the expected skill decision. EXPECTED USE / IGNORE reflects the documented scope in SKILL.md frontmatter. This corpus is consumed two ways: (1) a structure test in tests/test_project.py validates coverage and description consistency; (2) tests/evaluation/README.md prescribes the manual protocol for verifying real model trigger behavior. No automated model run has been performed; do not cite this file as evidence of tested triggering.
